title: zynseq state
description: Full zynseq state, as produced by getState() and accepted by setState(). It is what the snapshots store under "zynseq". setState() re-initialises the whole sequencer first (every pattern and scene is discarded), then loads what is present: all top-level keys are optional. Patterns are described in pattern.schema.json; getState only writes patterns that contain at least one event. A parse error or a malformed structure makes setState() log the problem, reset the sequencer and return false. 'Written' / 'read' below refer to getState() / setState(): some keys are written for information only and ignored on load, and a few are read but never written.

tempo.description: Main tempo in BPM. When missing, the current tempo is kept.

bpb.description: Default time signature: beats per bar.

scene.description: Selected scene (index into 'scenes'). When missing, the lowest scene present in 'scenes' (0 if none).

patns.description: Patterns, keyed by pattern id (a decimal string). Tracks refer to them by that id. getState() omits the key when there are none; convertToJson() (legacy snapshot conversion) writes null.

scenes.description: Scenes. The index in this array is the scene number. A scene without phrases is written as null.

phrases.description: Phrases of the scene, in order. The index in this array is the phrase number.

phrase.description: A phrase (a row of the launcher / arranger). It is itself a sequence, on the special channel 32 (the phrase launcher), that contains one child sequence per channel.

mode.description: Play mode bit field, same as for sequences. Only applied when present.

bpb.description: Time signature (beats per bar) of the phrase. Zero or negative values are replaced by 4.

tempo.description: Tempo of the phrase in BPM. 0 means the phrase has no tempo of its own.

repeat.description: Phrase length in bars. 0 = disabled, 255 = automatic (as long as its longest child sequence). NOTE the default when missing is 1, unlike sequences (255).

sequences.description: Child sequences of the phrase. The index in this array is the sequence number (0..31, the channel they are launched from); at most 32 are used. A missing sequence is written as null.

group.description: Group: sequences of the same group are mutually exclusive (starting one stops the others).

repeat.description: Number of times the sequence plays once started: 0 = disabled (never plays, e.g. the channel has no chain), 1..254 = that many times, 255 = loop forever. When missing, 255 (sequences loop by default). getState() always writes it. An explicit 0 is always kept.

followAction.description: Legacy. Child sequences have no follow action of their own any more: the value is NOT kept on load (it always loads as 0). It is only read as a legacy marker for an endless loop: a non-zero value with a non-zero 'repeat' loads as repeat = 255 (older files marked an endless loop with followAction = 1 and followParam = 0). getState() still writes 1 for sequences created by the sequencer.

playFlags.description: Read on load, never written for sequences.

followRepeat.description: Read on load, never written for sequences.

nBeats.description: Informational, written only: sum of the beats of the patterns of all the tracks. Ignored on load.

nEvents.description: Informational, written only: sum of the events of the patterns of all the tracks. Ignored on load.

tracks.description: Tracks of the sequence (normally one; omitted by getState when it has none). The index in this array is the track number.

timebase.description: Timebase events (tempo and time signature changes along the sequence). Optional; written only when the sequence has any.

map.description: Map / scale index applied to the notes of the track.

patns.description: Patterns of the track: the key is the start position within the track, in sequencer clocks (decimal string; 1920 clocks per beat), the value is the pattern id (a key of the top-level 'patns'). Written only when the track has patterns.

bar.description: Bar at which the event occurs.

tick.description: Clock within the bar at which the event occurs (0 for time signature events).

type.description: 1 = tempo change (value in BPM), 2 = time signature change (value in beats per bar).

playMode.description: Bit field: bits 0..1 = stop mode (0 stop at the end of the sequence, 1 stop at the next sync point, 2 stop immediately); bit 2 = start mode (0 start at the next sync point, 4 start immediately). Default 1 (stop at sync, start at sync).

playState.description: Play state when the state was saved. Informational, written only: ignored on load (everything loads stopped). 0 stopped, 1 playing, 2 starting, 3 stopping, 4 forced stop, 5 stopping at sync, 6 child playing, 8 child stopping.

followAction.description: What to do when the phrase ends: 0 none, 1 relative (go to the phrase 'followParam' phrases away; 0 = loop itself), 2 absolute (go to phrase number 'followParam').

followParam.description: Follow action parameter: relative offset in phrases (may be negative) or absolute phrase number.

playFlags.description: Bit field of the play loops to skip.

followRepeat.description: Number of times a (backward) follow action is repeated. 0 = no limit.
